name: 6 Grattan Street
bedsNote: + small attic room; front reception room could be a 4th
tagline: A double-fronted period townhouse with a long private garden and stone shed, in the centre of Portlaoise.

pros.detail: Leaves €300k for a full restoration and still lands under €500k. Stamp duty about €1,950.

pros.text: Ground-floor bathroom plus a spare reception room
pros.detail: One of the twin front reception rooms can become the parents' bedroom, and the only bathroom (rolltop bath) is already downstairs.

Midland Regional Hospital Portlaoise, roughly 1.5 km; a new ED extension with paediatric rooms opened May 2026. A downgrade was mooted in 2017 but never happened; 2026 reports of surgeons being redeployed to Tullamore are worth watching.
Portlaoise station is in town; frequent Cork/Limerick-line trains, fastest about an hour.
Portlaoise Educate Together NS 310 m, Gaelscoil Phort Laoise 560 m, Scoil Bhríde 730 m.

pros.text: Long private garden with vehicle access
pros.detail: Arched gated entrance, old stone shed; a rare yard for a town-centre house.
Dunamase College (mixed) 400 m and Portlaoise College 600 m; St Mary's CBS (boys, 839 pupils) 2.3 km.

cons.detail: A terrace on a Portlaoise street; neighbours on both sides and only the rear garden for space. The opposite of the room-to-breathe the brief wants.
Worst energy band. A full retrofit is a rough €60–100k before SEAI grants.
The listing calls it a 'massive site' with a 'huge', very private rear garden and vehicle access, but gives no area; it won't be an acre. Ask for the folio map.
Three bedrooms and one bathroom; adding a second bathroom eats into space.

cons.text: Six months on the market, 31,000 views
cons.detail: Listed April 2026; ask what surveys found.

cons.text: Rental appeal is local lets, not holiday
cons.detail: Lets as a town house, not a summer rental.

rating.basis: No published inspection report found on gov.ie; 420 pupils (221 boys/199 girls), non-DEIS, multi-denominational, large and growing, which suggests demand but is not a quality verdict.

rating.basis: Newer LOETB mixed school (554 pupils, non-DEIS, free); no progression figure or inspection report retrieved; Laois county average progression was ~71% (2023).

trips.note: Boys only, 839 pupils, free, 2.3 km; Scoil Chríost Rí (girls, ~104-111%) is the town's top school but unusable for sons.

rating.basis: Established ERST boys' school, the largest in Laois (839 boys), with a solid local reputation; exact Irish Times progression % not retrievable (charts are JS-only), so 'Good' is moderate-confidence.

questions: What is the site size, and where exactly are the boundaries?

ai.why: Very cheap with a train and ED in town, but a town terrace is far from the brief.

internet.detail: Fibre or cable likely; the house is in Portlaoise town centre, which has open eir FTTH and Virgin Media cable coverage — listing says nothing, so confirm on the eircode R32 TF1P.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: No bedroom downstairs; a front reception room could convert, beside the ground-floor bathroom.
